tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: Build every mod into its bin\ folder. Does not touch the game.

tasks.label: deploy to game
tasks.detail: Build every mod and copy it into the game's BepInEx\plugins folder. Close the game first.

tasks.label: package for Thunderstore
tasks.detail: Make a Thunderstore zip for every mod in Thunderstore\bin. Doesn't upload anything.
